title: Unsafe payment payload handling

ground_truth_finding.problem: Potential NullPointerException on calling card.getNumber() when payload.getCard() returns null.
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If payload has no card associated, payload.getCard() returns null, causing card.getNumber() to throw NullPointerException.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Add a null check to ensure card is not null before calling card.getNumber().

title: Incorrect transfer balance bounds check

ground_truth_finding.problem: Incorrect bounds check for balance transfer
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If balance is exactly equal to the transfer amount, the check passes but can leave the balance empty or cause business logic issue depending on overdraft rules.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Use from.getBalance() < amount or from.getBalance() <= amount correctly.

title: Unsafe reference equality for string checks

ground_truth_finding.problem: String reference equality comparison used instead of equals()
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If status string is loaded from DB or different reference, status == 'AVAILABLE' will evaluate to false even if the value matches.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Use "AVAILABLE".equals(status) instead.

title: Incorrect return on failure

ground_truth_finding.problem: Method returns true even in case of SMS sending failure exception
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If provider fails and throws exception, caller still gets 'true', hiding failures.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Return false inside the catch block.

title: Off-by-one array boundary error

ground_truth_finding.problem: Off-by-one loop boundary index causes IndexOutOfBoundsException
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Loop condition index evaluates at items.size() causing items.get(items.size()) to throw IndexOutOfBoundsException.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Change the loop condition to i < items.size().

title: Missing edge case for empty user creation

ground_truth_finding.problem: Missing validation for empty or blank name strings
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If user passes an empty name (e.g. ""), the method proceeds to save a user with an empty name.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Validate that the name is not empty or blank using name.trim().isEmpty().

title: Invalid state transition flow

ground_truth_finding.problem: Allows shipping status mutation on CANCELLED order state
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If order has already been cancelled, the state transition ignores this and marks it as SHIPPED.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Restore the state guard condition to prevent mutations on CANCELLED orders.

title: Unsafe list element retrieval

ground_truth_finding.problem: Accessing first index of list without checking if it is empty
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Passing an empty list to getLatestReport throws IndexOutOfBoundsException.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Add checks if list is null or empty before calling list.get(0).

title: Swallowing exceptions in caching logic

ground_truth_finding.problem: Empty catch block swallows connection or write exception silently
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Redis write failure is completely swallowed, leaving devs unaware of cache outages.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Log the exception or rethrow a custom cache exception.

title: Missing transactional context

ground_truth_finding.problem: Database mutation lacks transaction context
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If orderRepository.save fails, the account save will not roll back, resulting in a database state mismatch.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Add @Transactional annotation to ensure operations rollback on failure.

title: Unsafe optional get retrieval

ground_truth_finding.problem: Calling Optional.get() without verifying if product exists
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If repository findById(id) returns an empty Optional, Optional.get() throws NoSuchElementException.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Use orElse(null) or check isPresent() before calling get().

title: Unclosed BufferedReader stream resource leak

ground_truth_finding.problem: Resource BufferedReader is opened but not closed on exit
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If FileReader fails or files are read repeatedly, it will leak OS file descriptors and exhaust resources.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Use try-with-resources statement to auto-close BufferedReader.

title: Hardcoded secret key exposure

ground_truth_finding.problem: Hardcoded API secret token exposed in source code
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If source code is checked into repository, any user with access to source code can view and abuse this secret key.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Read the secret key from secure environment variable configuration.

title: Missing parameter input check

ground_truth_finding.problem: Missing validation pattern regex mapping check for input name
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: An attacker can input malicious parameter patterns or SQL-injection style queries through parameter input.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Restore the validation checks using regex patterns or standard validator annotations.

title: Raw query sql injection vulnerability

ground_truth_finding.problem: Raw SQL concatenation introduces SQL injection risk
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: An attacker can pass input as "' OR '1'='1" to bypass checks and extract user credentials.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Use SQL placeholders or PreparedStatement binding instead.

title: Path traversal security risk

ground_truth_finding.problem: Path parameter not sanitized against directory traversal attacks
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: An attacker can pass path as "../../../../etc/passwd" to read system config files.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Validate that the file path does not contain relative directory markers like '..'.

title: Weak HMAC JWT signing verification

ground_truth_finding.problem: Weak key and HS256 HMAC-SHA256 signature algorithm choice in JWT token service
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Weak secret keys like 'weak' can be brute-forced easily offline, enabling jwt forgery.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Use stronger keys with asymmetric cryptographic key pairs like RS256.

title: Missing check on resource ownership

ground_truth_finding.problem: Missing authorization check for order ownership mapping
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: A user can modify the orderId parameter to inspect orders belonging to other users.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Enforce checks to verify the order owner matches the logged in user.

title: Logging password string values

ground_truth_finding.problem: Sensitive password data logged in plain text
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: System logs will contain plain-text passwords, potentially violating GDPR/security requirements.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Do not log plain-text passwords. Log only generic status messages.

title: Insecure config wildcard rule

ground_truth_finding.problem: Admin API endpoints configured with permitAll validation rule wildcard
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Endpoints starting with /api/admin/ are exposed to public access, letting unauthenticated clients trigger admin features.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Enforce authorization rules like hasRole('ADMIN') on admin paths.

title: Deserializing input stream object directly

ground_truth_finding.problem: Unsafe Java native deserialization from untrusted stream source
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: An attacker can upload a serialized gadget payload, triggering arbitrary code execution on readObject().
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Avoid native Java deserialization; use safer formats like JSON or implement class verification filters.

title: Validating tokens without checks on validation date expiration

ground_truth_finding.problem: Validation fails to check if token is expired
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Users can use expired tokens to access secure endpoints infinitely.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Enforce expiration checks before approving token signature validation.

title: Missing account balance check authorization validation

ground_truth_finding.problem: Missing client parameter account ID authorization ownership validation check
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: An authenticated user can arbitrary modify another user's balance account by changing accountId.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Check the permission of the current session user on the targeted accountId.

title: Redirect parameter vulnerability

ground_truth_finding.problem: Open redirection vulnerability allows redirecting users to external untrusted domains
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: An attacker can craft a link redirecting to a malicious phishing page under target site identity.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Sanitize parameter redirect target against whitelist before sending redirect headers.

title: Unused private method helper

ground_truth_finding.problem: Unused private helper method logUnusedInfo should be cleaned
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Unused private methods increase noise in codebase and increase maintenance effort.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Remove the unused private method.

title: Dead local variable initialization

ground_truth_finding.problem: Dead code local variable initialized but never used
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Increases cognitive load on reading code logic.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Remove the unused local variable offset.

title: Redundant ternary expression boolean map

ground_truth_finding.problem: Redundant ternary conditional expression to return a boolean value
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Adds unnecessary verbose logic wrapper to simple comparisons.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Simplify expression to return x == y; directly.

title: Redundant boolean check comparison

ground_truth_finding.problem: Redundant comparison of boolean variable with literal 'true'
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Redundant boolean check syntax reduces code readability.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Simplify condition expression check to if (active).

title: Deeply nested condition block complexity

ground_truth_finding.problem: Nested condition logic block causes unnecessary cognitive complexity code smells
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Deeply nested if blocks make reading loop path controls and editing codebase harder.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Collapse checks into a single boolean combination guard condition: active && verified && optIn.

title: Duplicated string parser logic block

ground_truth_finding.problem: Duplicated date formatting parser logic block
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: If default format changes, devs must update both methods, risking inconsistent behavior.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Reuse parseDefault(val) helper inside parseSecondary(val).

title: Misleading temp variable identifier

ground_truth_finding.problem: Misleading local variable identifier named 'temp' instead of descriptive label
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: N/A
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Use a descriptive variable name such as orderId.

title: Generic Exception exception throwing

ground_truth_finding.problem: Generic class Exception thrown instead of specific IOException
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Callers cannot handle specific failure modes and are forced to catch generic Exception.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Throw specific exceptions like IOException.

title: Unnecessary type conversions loop

ground_truth_finding.problem: Unnecessary string-to-int-to-string type conversions
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Causes unnecessary CPU cycles, memory allocations, and introduces NumberFormatException risk.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Remove the redundant parsing conversion logic.

title: Unreachable conditional branches

ground_truth_finding.problem: Nested condition introduces unreachable code path
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: N/A
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Remove the unreachable nested condition block.

title: Confusing loop control statements flow

ground_truth_finding.problem: Tangled control flow with premature loop breaks and continues
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Makes it difficult to determine when loop execution terminates.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Simplify loops with clear filtering checks or standard stream pipelines.

title: Unnecessary config mutability state variables

ground_truth_finding.problem: Constant configuration field exposes unnecessary mutability state variables
ground_truth_finding.failure_scenario: Other components can mistakenly modify the appVersion config property.
ground_truth_finding.suggested_fix: Declare the configuration constant property as private static final.
